validator.source_text:
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml"
       xmlns:c="urn:example:custom"
       initial="missing">
  <state id="ready">
    <transition event="finish, abort" target="don"/>
    <c:mark value="not-an-integer"/>
    <log expr="'misplaced'"/>
  </state>
  <state id="ready"/>
  <final id="done"/>
</scxml>

notes: the W3C SCXML 1.0 schema rejects this under XML Schema constraint `cvc-complex-type.4`: Required attribute 'version' is missing
spec_references: XML Schema 1.0 Part 1 §3.4.4 Element Locally Valid (Complex Type) (`cvc-complex-type.4`)

diagnostics.message: cannot resolve an XML Schema for namespace `urn:example:custom`

primary.message: no schema is registered for it

notes: schema lookup uses the exact namespace URI; the SCXML namespace uses the bundled W3C SCXML 1.0 schema by default, and every other namespace used under the strict policy needs an explicitly registered schema
diagnostics.help: register a schema with `--schema urn:example:custom=PATH.xsd`, or validate with `--policy lax` to skip namespaces without a schema

notes: the `initial` attribute of `<scxml>` or `<state>` selects the states entered first; an unknown ID, or an empty list, leaves the initial configuration undefined
diagnostics.help: declare the initial state or correct the identifier

diagnostics.message: event descriptors are whitespace-separated, not comma-separated
notes: `event` is a whitespace-separated list of descriptors (`a`, `a.b`, `a.*`, `*`); commas and other punctuation never match
diagnostics.help: replace commas with spaces; each descriptor is matched independently

notes: a transition's `target` must be one or more IDs of states in the same SCXML document; an unresolved target makes the document non-conformant

fixes.message: a state with a similar name exists: `done`

diagnostics.message: this compiler cannot lower `<c:mark>` from namespace `urn:example:custom` inside `<state>`

secondary.message: this compiler lowers only SCXML children of `<state>`

notes: this is a limit of this toolchain, not an SCXML rule: SCXML 1.0 allows elements from other namespaces in its content models (the W3C schema's `##other` wildcards), but the compiler lowers them only as executable content (custom actions in `<onentry>`, `<onexit>`, `<transition>`, `<finalize>`, `<if>`, or `<foreach>`) and rejects them anywhere else rather than drop them silently
diagnostics.help: to compile the document with this toolchain, move the element into executable content, or remove it

notes: the W3C SCXML 1.0 schema rejects this under XML Schema constraint `cvc-complex-type.2.4`: Element 'log' is not allowed at this position in the content model
diagnostics.help: executable content such as `<log>` belongs inside `<onentry>`, `<onexit>`, or `<transition>`
spec_references: XML Schema 1.0 Part 1 §3.4.4 Element Locally Valid (Complex Type) (`cvc-complex-type.2.4`)

fixes.message: run it on entry by wrapping it in `<onentry>`

notes: transition targets, `initial` references, and history defaults resolve by ID; duplicates make every reference ambiguous
diagnostics.help: choose a unique identifier and update every reference to it
